presentation.label: Four mute modes
presentation.summary: Choose a stock cut, FX tails, trig suppression or amp-envelope completion for muted and soloed-out audio tracks.
presentation.overview: Choose a stock cut, FX tails, trig suppression or amp-envelope completion for muted and soloed-out audio tracks.
highlights: OT is the default. The global PERSONALIZE setting is stored in battery SRAM; it is not a Part or project setting.
An OS upgrade resets PERSONALIZE. Saving or switching Parts/projects does not make the mode project-specific.
SIDECHAIN_COMPRESSOR requires its SC_KEY assembly variant so a muted key continues feeding the compressor.
usage: Open PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE and select MUTE MODE.
Choose OTFX to cut the dry signal while delay and reverb tails continue; trigs keep firing underneath.
Mute and unmute an audio track with a long delay or reverb tail, then try OTFX-T to suppress new trigs.
Choose DT-T to let the current voice finish its amp envelope, or OT to restore the stock cut.

limitations: OT is the default. The global PERSONALIZE setting is stored in battery SRAM; it is not a Part or project setting.

resources.recorded: 3 November 2026; authored-source assembly and isolated native-code probes of 0.2.2

storage.label: Authored code and relocated menu tables
storage.conditions: Program bytes 1204 (mm_softmute 996, mm_menu 208; mm_softmute is 1106 beside Sidechain Compressor), tables 204. UNHELD, SHADOW and KEYMASK live inside mm_softmute. This is a standalone source footprint, not a complete common-builder or stock memory inventory. Actual probe stack peaks and model timing are recorded separately.

processing.label: ColdFire native paths
processing.display: Measured model cycles; chip wall-clock pending
processing.conditions: MCF5206E core-cycle model, cache-hit zero-wait; not MCF54455 chip timing. Synthetic stock callbacks exclude their actual work. Conservative V4 code-cycle path bounds exclude cache, bus and interrupt contention; see TESTING.md.

impact.conditions: Source estimate for eight audio tracks; no added DSP program. Complete timing and placement remain pending.

cpu.rationale: Finite ColdFire hook paths with bounded eight-track loops; native paths and stack peaks were measured.

dsp.rationale: No new DSP program; existing voice and FX dispatch is retained.

memory.rationale: Small authored ROM patches and reused stock state; no new audio buffer allocation.

cpuPrice.conditions: MKI, development twin fc4b7abd of base 0.7.9 with this version as the PERSONALIZE table owner (the beta flags plus --dev), the author's project, bank A pattern A02 (12 steps) on Part 1 playing, nothing muted, MUTE MODE at the installed default, 8 s per reading, two runs: frame interrupt 48.9 % before and 50.6 % installed (+1.7), then 49.2 % and 50.7 % (+1.5); CPU meter +1.8 and +1.4. With T1-T4 muted and MUTE MODE OTFX-T the same reading was 33.9 % against 49.3 % for stock's mute (CPU 46.9 against 61.3 %): OTFX-T starts no new notes on muted tracks, so the price is the unmuted case.

tests.summary: 0.2.3 adds the ev_trig_muted answer; the native units are unchanged, and the native probe reproduces 0.2.2's evidence byte for byte. Over USB on the author's MKI (16 November 2026) this version's release package installed on a development twin of base 0.7.5 and passed every mode with a muted track (OT, OTFX, OTFX-T, DT-T), a soloed track in DT-T, a power cycle (restored from the card, MUTE MODE kept) and removal. The ev_trig_muted answer equals the resets mm_voice_bind drops in every frame of loader_mute_keep_fixture (emulator); no machine that asks it had a package yet, so it was not exercised on the unit.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: keep FX tails when muting
steps: Open PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE and select MUTE MODE.
Choose OTFX to cut the dry signal while delay and reverb tails continue; trigs keep firing underneath.
Mute and unmute an audio track with a long delay or reverb tail, then try OTFX-T to suppress new trigs.
Choose DT-T to let the current voice finish its amp envelope, or OT to restore the stock cut.

conditions.parameterExtremes: All four MUTE MODE values and every eight-bit mute and solo mask with SOLO_FLAG set and clear, plain and SC_KEY variants, and the hold from an OT frame into each soft mode (evidence/probes.json, 4,353,132 executed cases). ev_trig_muted (0.2.3), asked through the base's raise after every frame of loader_mute_keep_fixture: every MUTE MODE, mute and solo masks with SOLO_FLAG set and clear, four SIDE-CHAIN KEY layouts, with and without an ev_mute_keep provider (244 asks, 94 dropping trigs): at most 34 instructions per ask, 16 in mm_trig_muted itself.
conditions.parameterModulation: Not applicable: MUTE MODE is one global PERSONALIZE setting; mute and solo change from the panel or MIDI and are read once per frame.
conditions.modeSwitching: MUTE MODE changed between frames in every order; mutes and solos set and cleared between frames, including the 0->1 edge that issues each track's note-off.
conditions.maxLoad: One instance (a global setting). Per 16-sample block: the frame hook once (at most 3,440, SC_KEY variant in OTFX; 2,176 plain) plus the per-trig hooks for all eight tracks in the same block, 8 x (336 + 336 + 352 + 320 + 304) = 13,184. Over USB a machine that starts its own note asks ev_trig_muted once per trig: at most eight asks per block, 8 x 544 = 4,352 more (16,624 + 4,352 = 20,976).
conditions.inputConditions: Independent of audio content. Conservative V4 core-path bounds from the actual assembled instructions of this version (16 cycles per ordinary instruction), not chip wall-clock timing; stock callbacks (the note-off and voice routines) are stock cost and excluded.

regions.name: Authored ColdFire code and its RAM bytes, unit mm_softmute (plain; 1,106 bytes beside Sidechain Compressor)
PERSONALIZE menu row code, unit mm_menu
Three PERSONALIZE pointer tables grown from 16 to 17 entries
Six jmp detours written over stock instructions in place
Row-count poke and three ANDY restore length pokes
MUTE MODE setting word (a free PERSONALIZE word) and its battery copy

memory.conditions: From the linked units and the manifest's detours, tables and pokes. UNHELD, SHADOW and KEYMASK are bytes inside mm_softmute (counted there); since 0.2.2 the module keeps no state in stock-owned SRAM. No heap; at most 24 bytes of stack beyond the stock frame routine (evidence/probes.json).

hardware.summary: The author ran this version's USB release package (d460c7e2) on an Octatrack MKI, OS 1.40C: the Modwerk base flashed from a development build of the site (1625fef6), then a development twin of base 0.7.5 with this version as the PERSONALIZE table owner (4b375949) booted from RAM over USB, and the package installed through the session. All passed, as the author reported: with T1 muted while playing, OT cuts at once with its tails, OTFX cuts the dry sound and lets the FX tails ring out, OTFX-T also drops new trigs, DT-T lets the sounding note finish and drops new trigs (the MUTE MODE word and mute word read back over USB each time); soloing T2 in DT-T silences the others; after a power cycle and a new RAM boot the twin restored the module from the card with MUTE MODE still on DT-T; removal (from the main page) was accepted, the MUTE MODE row left PERSONALIZE and a mute cut as stock. Removal with PERSONALIZE open was refused (loader refusal 7), as the table owner guard intends.
limitations: MKI only; not run on an MKII.
No machine that asks ev_trig_muted (FM Synth 0.1.4) had a package, so the answer itself was checked in the emulator only.
Sidechain Compressor's package is bound to the flashed base, not the twin, so a muted SIDE-CHAIN key track was not run in this version.
Functional checks reported by the author; no stress run, frame-interrupt load or chip timing capture.
